findings.message: 115 of 119 built-in actions lack located compiled-binary/process packaged proof.
All built-in actions have a registry contract and exact composite handler; exact packaged selection is proven for only 4 actions.
Plugin commands/skills and generated skills/aliases/agents/hooks/manifests lack package/install containment proof; compiled workflow/config/runbook sources have only aggregate build proof.
10 of 11 standalone CLI commands lack exact compiled-binary/process proof.
Documentation authorities are intentionally unshipped and require semantic drift checks, not packaged-runtime containment.

limitations: Orchestrate action handler expressions are extracted from ACTION_HANDLERS and seven explicit special-action branches; packaged proof is credited only when a process test invokes the exact action.
A test that merely imports a handler or source adapter is not counted as packaged proof.
Process tests are credited only for the exact actions named in their assertions.

affectedRows: workflow, event, and view handler edges

failedProbes.error: The first extractor used the wrong action-name field and omitted the large map plus seven special/computed branches.
